name: toggle-41
description: Large tile toggles for smart home devices with an on count.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { DoorClosedIcon, FanIcon, LightbulbIcon, ThermometerIcon, } from "lucide-react" import { Toggle } from "@workspace/ui/components/toggle" const devices = [ { name: "Living room", icon: LightbulbIcon, on: true }, { name: "Ceiling fan", icon: FanIcon, on: false }, { name: "Heating", icon: ThermometerIcon, on: true }, { name: "Front door", icon: DoorClosedIcon, on: false }, ] export default function SmartHomeDeviceTiles() { const [state, setState] = React.useState(devices.map((d) => d.on)) return (

{state.filter(Boolean).length} of {devices.length} devices on

{devices.map((d, i) => ( setState((prev) => prev.map((v, j) => (j === i ? on : v))) } className="h-auto flex-col items-start gap-3 p-3 aria-pressed:border-primary aria-pressed:bg-primary aria-pressed:text-primary-foreground" > {d.name} {state[i] ? "On" : "Off"} ))}
) }
